title: Lightly Charred Brazilian Myeongnan Roe Skewers
description: A quick fix Brazilian dish featuring myeongnan roe, whisked to perfection and cooked to a tender char, served in a ramekin, this ayurvedic tamasic friendly recipe is a delight to the senses, with the myeongnan roe providing a unique flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the myeongnan roe to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated myeongnan roe onto the bamboo skewers.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Serve the skewers in a ramekin, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Cook the skewers to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 1 minute before serving.
